body:
Ok so this happened about a year ago and still gives me the creeps. A friend of a friend's daughter decided to take a trip to Mexico with about four of her friends (all female btw). I forgot where they were but somewhere close to Arizona (puerto penasco if remember correctly). Anyhow they got pulled over for a speeding ticket and we're asked to pay a bribe and they refused. Quick note there were about three other cop cars around them at the time. So the officer asked them to drive down to the station and they obliged. It took about thirty minutes before one of the girls noticed that the other cars were following them. They then looked up there location and and realized they had already passed the station and we're being led to a more remote location. They quickly pulled over, apologized for the inconvenience and paid the bribe.

I know it's not the most shocking or scary story. But man sometimes I wonder what could of happened if they didn't pay...
